topic: Murasu dumped *231.8 mm* on one village.
hook: Murasu dumped *231.8 mm* on one village. Hyderabad stayed dry
hook_b: Murasu dumped *231.8 mm* on one village. Hyderabad stayed dry
tldr: Murasu's rain hit Khammam and Bhadradri Kothagudem hardest; Hyderabad got mostly cloud.

beats.what: Extremely heavy to very heavy rain fell in Khammam and Bhadradri Kothagudem; Mulakalapally logged 231.8 mm.
beats.why: Murasu weakened into a depression over Telangana and AP after crossing the Andhra coast.
beats.care: Hyderabad's water crisis is unchanged by this rain. East Telangana roads and low crossings stay risky.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: Hyderabad and several other districts mostly saw overcast skies and minimal rain. Deccan Chronicle reports a flash flood alert for Bhadradri Kothagudem. The News Minute reports 2 deaths and 312 damaged houses in Andhra Pradesh.
